speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Shrew went on at two without me. I did not hear it. Ranger's Comedy went on at the Rose. I did not hear that either.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I struck one line and I stopped. The owl is not written. The last line is not written. Tomorrow, before dinner, I shut the door, or I admit I cannot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is still on her table. I am not answering it tonight to make the desk look finished.
